body:
Humans have no way to rename or delete a design.

## Asked for

- A human can rename a design.
- A human can delete a design.
- Deleting a design must not cause problems anywhere that refers to it.

## Done when

- Renaming changes the design's title everywhere it's shown, and its versions are kept.
- Deleting removes the design and all its versions from the list.
- After a delete, nothing that referred to it breaks: task briefs that link it (D-252), notes that pointed at its elements (D-245, which keep the design's title), an open design run, and other designs' version history and changes view. Each is covered by a test.
- Spec 15 and DECISIONS.md cover rename and delete.

## Calls made

- Restore stays. Restore goes back to an earlier version of a design you keep. Delete removes the whole design. They do different jobs, so there's still one way to do each.

## Open (ask the human)

- Whether delete asks for confirmation first, and whether a deleted design can be brought back.
- Where the rename and delete controls go.
